# netactuate_nke_worker_node (Resource)

Manages a NKE Worker Node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_nke_worker_node" "example" {
  cluster_id     = 12345
  worker_node_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) NKE cluster ID that owns the worker node.
- `worker_node_id` (Number) NKE worker node ID.

### Optional

- `label` (String) Worker node label.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number) Tag IDs to apply to the worker node.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `location_id` (Number) Worker node location ID.
- `location_name` (String) Worker node location name.
- `name` (String) Worker node name.
- `package_id` (Number) Worker node package ID.
- `package_name` (String) Worker node package name.
- `status_ready` (Boolean) Whether the worker node is ready.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_nke_worker_node.example 12345
```
